title: Mutant Monsters - Programmer Art
description: Adds Programmer Art textures for the Mutant Monsters mod, making its items, mobs, and effects match the pre 1.14 style.
body:
This pack adds Programmer Art textures for the Mutant Monsters mod, making its items, mobs, and effects match old Minecraft.

It’s meant to be used with the official Programmer Art pack and the Programmer Art continuation pack.
